code_004.reason: Panel readers stretched this code to cover cases where internal knowledge deduction was missed or evidence was misinterpreted, showing its scope definition was too narrow.
code_004.name: Inverted or Unsound Deductive Reasoning
code_004.definition: The agent draws a logical conclusion or truth judgment that directly contradicts its own verified premises, makes an unwarranted logical jump, or misinterprets evidence to reach an unsound deduction.
code_004.when_to_use: Use when an agent correctly observes facts or premises but draws an opposite, invalid, or unsupported logical conclusion.
code_004.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the reasoning error is caused by misinterpreting claim syntax, relying on ungrounded external facts, or producing non-query outputs.

code_007.reason: The code cleanly identifies search queries that omit explicitly deduced target entities or required bridge terms.

code_008.subject: candidate
code_008.reason: The code specifies the observable omission of mandatory output completion markers required by instructions.

code_009.subject: candidate
code_009.reason: The code accurately identifies missing structural sections or section headers in emitted agent outputs.

code_010.subject: candidate
code_010.reason: The code specifically names search query syntax in its title and definition, making it an instruction detector that is too narrow for general non-compliant output formatting.
code_010.name: Output Form Specifying Against Instructions
code_010.definition: The agent produces an output whose form, character usage, syntax, or formatting its own instructions explicitly specify against.
code_010.when_to_use: Use when an output string violates syntax rules, character constraints, or formatting structures specified in the candidate's instructions.
code_010.when_not_to_use: Do not use when the output complies with syntax rules but omits required target entities, or when required structural sections are omitted entirely.

code_011.subject: candidate
code_011.reason: Focuses specifically on entity title casing, making it an instruction detector that panel readers stretched to fit list ordering and element formatting violations.
code_011.name: Non-Compliance with Required Element Formatting Rules
code_011.definition: The agent produces output elements or values whose string casing, title normalization, or structural ordering fails to follow specific formatting rules required by its instructions.
code_011.when_to_use: Use when emitted output elements or entity titles fail to follow required text casing, normalization, sorting, or formatting constraints.
code_011.when_not_to_use: Do not use when an output section or element is omitted entirely.
